summary.text: At a glance: EQUINOR ASA is a public limited company (ASA) in Stavanger, working in utvinning av råolje; 21,182 registered employees and operating revenue USD 67,956,000,000 in 2025, down 6% on 2024; website https://www.equinor.com.

What's new (past 12 months, newest first): 2026-11-13 latest of 10 news posts on its website: "Ex. dividend second quarter 2026 today - OSE"; 2026-11-12 employee count updated: 21182; 2026-10-13 employee count updated: 21231; 2026-09-14 employee count updated: 21272; 2026-09-04 board registration changed (chair: Jarle Kjell Roth); 2026-08-18 annual accounts filed: 2025 (operating revenue down 6% on 2024); +10 more.

What it does: Primary industry: 06.100 Utvinning av råolje. Registered purpose: Å utvikle, produsere og markedsføre ulike former for energi, avledede produkter og tjenester, samt annen virksomhet. Virksomheten kan også drives gjennom deltakelse i eller i samarbeid med andre selskaper.
Business address: Forusbeen 50, 4035 STAVANGER, Norge (STAVANGER municipality).
Size: 21,182 registered employees; latest filed company accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31): operating revenue USD 67,956,000,000, annual result USD 5,731,000,000.
People: CEO (daglig leder): Anders Opedal; board chair: Jarle Kjell Roth; 8 other board members; auditor: ERNST & YOUNG AS.
Locations: 35 active sub-units registered (incl. ÅGOTNES, RJUKAN, KOPERVIK, HARSTAD, KRISTIANSUND N).
Status: no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced-dissolution flags registered.

Identity: share capital NOK 5,976,872,600 (registered 2026-07-02); formerly registered as STATOIL ASA (until 2018-05-16), STATOILHYDRO ASA (until 2009-11-02), STATOIL ASA (until 2007-10-01) and 1 earlier name.
Website: https://www.equinor.com (as registered, and verified on the site).
Company-owned profiles linked from its website: https://facebook.com/Equinor, https://instagram.com/equinor, https://linkedin.com/company/equinor, https://x.com/Equinor.
Hiring: no active job ads on arbeidsplassen.no (NAV) for this company or its sub-units.
Recent registry activity: 2026-11-12 employee count updated: 21182; 2026-10-13 employee count updated: 21231; 2026-09-14 employee count updated: 21272 (17 events since 2025).

Latest news on its website: 2026-11-13 "Ex. dividend second quarter 2026 today - OSE"; 2026-10-29 "Doubles North Sea gas discovery estimate"; 2026-10-28 "Equinor to commence fourth tranche of the 2026 share buy-back programme" (10 dated items since 2025).
